Method of Attack: Spreading and infecting Windows 10 and Windows 11 systems using malicious Windows AppX Installer packages camouflaged as Adobe PDF software
Phishing emails with stolen reply-chain emails instructing victims to open PDFs, redirecting to launch Windows App Installer to install malicious appxbundle
AppX Installer spoofing vulnerability exploited to distribute malware via malicious packages hosted on Microsoft Azure
Attack Vector: Malicious Windows AppX Installer packages installed via ms-appinstaller protocol handler
Phishing emails with embedded links launching Windows App Installer
Malicious packages hosted on Microsoft Azure using *.web.core.windows.net URLs
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious appxbundle hosted on Microsoft Azure
